effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: line
effects.css: .text{ position: relative; font-size: 40px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; } .text::before{ content: ''; position: absolute; background: linear-gradient(red, blue); height: 3px; width: 0px; left: 0%; right: 0%; bottom: 0%; transition: 0.2s linear; } .text:hover::before{ width: 100%; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: Underline Expand
effects.css: .text { position: relative; font-size: 40px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; } .text::after{ content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 50%; width: 0; height: 2px; background-color: blue; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .text:hover::after { left: 0%; width: 100%; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: Jump
effects.css: .text { position: relative; font-size: 40px; cursor: pointer; } .text span { display: inline-block; } @keyframes jump { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-10px); } } .text:hover span { animation: jump 1s ease infinite; } .text:hover span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; } .text:hover span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.05s; } .text:hover span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.1s; } .text:hover span:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.15s; } .text:hover span:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.2s; } .text:hover span:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.25s; } .text:hover span:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: letter spacing
effects.css: .text { position: relative; font-size: 40px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; transition: 0.3s ease; } .text:hover{ letter-spacing: 10px; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: filter blur
effects.css: .text { position: relative; font-size: 40px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; transition: 0.3s ease; } .text:hover{ filter: blur(2px); }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: multi-layer
effects.css: .text { position: relative; font-size: 40px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; transition: 0.3s ease; } .text:hover{ text-shadow: 1px 1px 0px red, 2px 2px 0px blue, 3px 3px 0px black; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: linear-gradient
effects.css: .text { font-size: 40px; font-weight: bold; background: linear-gradient(90deg, red, rgb(251, 0, 255), red); background-size: 200%; background-position: left; -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; transition: 0.5s ease; cursor: pointer; } .text:hover { animation: moveGradient 1s infinite linear alternate-reverse; } @keyframes moveGradient { 0% { background-position: 100%; } 100% { background-position: 0%; } }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: blink
effects.css: .text { font-size: 40px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; } .text:hover{ animation: blink 0.8s ease infinite; } @keyframes blink { 0%,100%{ opacity: 0.1; color: gold; } 50%{ opacity: 1; color: red; } }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: shadow
effects.css: .text { position: relative; font-size: 40px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; } .text::before { content: 'Hover Me'; position: absolute; transition: 0.5s linear; top: 0%; transform: rotateX(0deg); opacity: 0; } .text:hover::before{ opacity: 0.5; top: 60%; transform: rotateX(180deg); }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-text: Glow Effect
effects.css: .text { position: relative; font-size: 40px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; } .text:hover{ color: white; text-shadow: 2px 2px 5px violet; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: Basic
effects.css: .btn { padding: 10px; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s ease; } .btn:hover{ background-color: black; color: white; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: background runs to the right
effects.css: .btn { position: relative; padding: 10px; font-size: 20px; color: black; background-color: transparent; border: 2px solid black; overflow: hidden; z-index: 1; cursor: pointer; } .btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -100%; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(to right, #00f, #0ff); z-index: -1; transition: left 0.5s ease; } .btn:hover::before { left: 0; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: Border scale
effects.css: .btn { padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 20px; color: white; background-color: black; border: 1px solid #fff; cursor: pointer; position: relative; transition: 0.5s ease; } .btn::before, .btn::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; transform: scale(0); border: 1px solid blue; transition: 0.5s ease; } .btn:hover { border: 1px solid blue; color: blue; box-shadow: inset 0px 0px 10px 1px blue; } .btn:hover::before { transform: scale(0.8); border: 1px solid blue; } .btn:hover::after { transform: scale(0.6); border: 1px solid blue; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: light
effects.css: .btn { position: relative; padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 20px; color: white; background-color: black; border: 2px solid #fff; cursor: pointer; overflow: hidden; z-index: 1; } .btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -75%; width: 50%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient( 120deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 100% ); transform: skewX(-20deg); transition: none; } .btn:hover::before { animation: shine 1s forwards; } @keyframes shine { from { left: -75%; } to { left: 125%; } }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: fly
effects.css: .btn { padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 20px; color: white; background-color: black; border: 1px solid #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s ease; } .btn:hover{ transform: translateY(-10px); box-shadow: 0px 10px 10px 5px black; }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: Scale
effects.css: .btn { padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 20px; color: white; background-color: black; border: 1px solid #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s ease; } .btn:hover{ transform: scale(1.1); }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: text rotation
effects.css: .btn { padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 20px; color: white; background-color: black; border: 1px solid #fff; cursor: pointer; position: relative; width: 100px; height: 50px; } .face{ position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; backface-visibility: hidden; transition: 0.3s ease; } .face.front{ transform: rotateY(0deg); } .face.back{ transform: rotateY(180deg); } .btn:hover .front{ transform: rotateY(180deg); } .btn:hover .back{ transform: rotateY(0deg); }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: background rotation
effects.css: .btn { padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer; position: relative; border: none; width: 100px; height: 50px; } .face{ position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; backface-visibility: hidden; transition: 0.3s ease; } .face.front{ background-color: black; color: white; border: 1px solid #fff; transform: rotateY(0deg); } .face.back{ background-color: white; color: black; border: 1px solid #000; transform: rotateY(180deg); } .btn:hover .front{ transform: rotateY(180deg); } .btn:hover .back{ transform: rotateY(0deg); }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: Text slides to the left
effects.css: .btn { padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 20px; color: white; background-color: black; border: 1px solid #fff; cursor: pointer; position: relative; width: 100px; height: 50px; } .face{ position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; transition: 0.5s ease; } .face.front{ transform: translateX(0px); } .face.back{ transform: translateX(100px); } .btn:hover .front{ transform: translateX(-100px); } .btn:hover .back{ transform: translateX(0px); }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: Text running off screen
effects.css: .btn { padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 20px; color: white; background-color: black; border: 1px solid #fff; cursor: pointer; position: relative; width: 100px; height: 50px; overflow: hidden; perspective: 800px; } .face{ position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; transition: 0.5s ease; } .face.front{ transform: translateZ(0px); } .face.back{ transform: translateZ(1000px); } .btn:hover .front{ transform: translateZ(1000px); } .btn:hover .back{ transform: translateZ(0px); }

effects.author: PhanVinh
effects.title: Hover-btn: Text running on screen
effects.css: .btn { padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 20px; color: white; background-color: black; border: 1px solid #fff; cursor: pointer; position: relative; width: 100px; height: 50px; overflow: hidden; perspective: 800px; } .face { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; transition: 0.5s ease; } .face.front { transform: translateZ(0px); opacity: 1; } .face.back { transform: translateZ(-10000px); opacity: 0; } .btn:hover .front { transform: translateZ(-10000px); opacity: 0; } .btn:hover .back { transform: translateZ(0px); opacity: 1; }
